Bill & Ted's Excellent Video Game Advent.name: Bill & Ted's Excellent Video Game Adventure
Bill & Ted's Excellent Video Game Advent.summary: Bill & Ted's Excellent Video Game Adventure is a Nintendo Entertainment System adventure game based off of the Bill & Ted franchise. It was developed by Rocket Science and released in 1991 as a continuation of the film "Bill & Ted's Excellent Adventure".

Lee Trevino's Fighting Golf.name: Lee Trevino's Fighting Golf
Lee Trevino's Fighting Golf.summary: Lee Trevino's Fighting Golf is a Golf Sim game, developed and published by SNK, which was released in 1988.

Rygar.name: Rygar
Rygar.summary: An open-world action-adventure game for the Nintendo Entertainment System that features a barbarian warrior with a distinctive "diskarmor" weapon. It is distinct from the original 1986 Arcade game Rygar, which saw numerous home console ports.

Spacegulls.name: Spacegulls
Spacegulls.summary:
Spacegulls is cute platformer featuring birds in space developed for the NES. It is best described as a combination of Joust and Mega Man. 1-2 players
The first version of Spacegulls was made in 1 week and won 1st place in the NESdev Compo 2020/21.

Teenage Mutant Hero Turtles II - The Arc.name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles II: The Arcade Game
Teenage Mutant Hero Turtles II - The Arc.summary: This version includes two new levels (the first part of Scene 3 and all of Scene 6), which feature new enemy characters, including two new bosses: Tora (a dog-like "blizzard beast") and Shogun (a robotic samurai), both characters created for the game. Most of the original stages from the arcade version were extended as well and the second half of Scene 3, the parking garage stage, replaces the arcade version's end battle with Bebop and Rocksteady with a battle against the mutated fly form of Baxter Stockman.

Tryptic.name: Tryptic
Tryptic.summary: A new sci-fi, multi-game adventure for your NES!
